messages:
Marta: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp hitting weird dims + duplicate batches when using Node SDK with rerank endpoint. Repro steps below.
Marta: Node SDK 0.9.1, example: `client.embeddings.create({model: 'open-redwood-embed-1024', input: ['a','b']})` returns vectors length 1536 for some inputs.
Marta: Python sampleapp (same model string) returns 1024-length vectors. Possible fallback to a 1536 model or rounding? Also seeing duplicate batch calls after an auth refresh.
Sam: ugh. do you have a minimal log? can you paste the request/response headers + auth flow trace?
Marta: pasted logs. truncated vectors to lengths only:
```
Request: POST /v1/embeddings { model: "open-redwood-embed-1024", inputs: ["a","b"] }
Node response: { embeddings: [ { vector_length: 1536 }, { vector_length: 1536 } ] }
Python response: { embeddings: [ { vector_length: 1024 }, { vector_length: 1024 } ] }
```
Marta: Auth trace: token expired -> sdk auto-refresh -> original batch retried -> duplicate second batch observed in server logs (same client_batch_id).
Jordan: hmm could be two separate issues: 1) model name mapping in Node SDK ends up resolving to a different variant (quantized/profiled) returning 1536, 2) the retry path doesn't attach idempotency key so server treats as new batch. do we have client_batch_id present?
Marta: client_batch_id is set by our helper: `batcher.makeBatchId()` and included in payload. But after auth refresh, Node's internal retry sends the original request without copying that header for some reason.
Ryan: can repro locally with `NODE_ENV=development node samples/embeddings-batch.js` — hitting it now. also see a failing assertion in the embed-rerank adapter:
```
assert.equal(body.embeddings[0].length, modelSpec.dim)
// modelSpec.dim = 1024
// body.embeddings[0].length = 1536
```
Sam: devex-bot FYI: this looks like SDK parity + retry header bug
devex-bot: Incident created: #INC-2024-1792 (assigned to eng-runtime)
Jordan: quick mitigation — add a guard in batcher to enforce dims before sending to rerank: if (vec.length !== expected) drop/log + surface a clearer error to users instead of asserting server-side. will open PR to patch Node SDK to copy idempotency header on retries.
Marta: thanks. logs show about ~0.5% of onboards hit this (mixed model routing). Most cases are when request goes to a variant with different embedding size under the hood.
Ryan: filing an infra ticket to check model alias map (maybe 'open-redwood-embed-1024' accidentally maps to family that has a 1536 variant).
Sam: can we also add a test in sampleapp CI that verifies dims across Node/Python parity for a few canonical prompts?
Jordan: yes — I'll add a cross-sdk parity test and a small harness that asserts idempotency header preserved across internal retries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2483 (WIP)
Marta: created a small repro gist and added to the onboarding doc: https://gist.github.com/marta/embed-onboard-dim-repro
Ryan: thanks — keeping this thread for status. if anyone sees weird rerank score deltas from production, ping here.
Sam: noted. will notify support to surface any customer reports. :thumbsup:
